title: JSON Schema Validation Rules and a RetryFor Attribute in Laravel 13.43
content:
Laravel 13.43 turns JSON schemas into validation rules, adds a #[RetryFor] queue attribute and releaseUsingBackoff(), and ships several security fixes.

The post JSON Schema Validation Rules and a RetryFor Attribute in Laravel 13.43 appeared first on Laravel News.
